Criterion: Verify that maintenance manuals provide adequate troubleshooting procedures to correct expected system/component failures. Standard: Maintenance manuals provide troubleshooting instructions and identify items (e.g., support equipment, supplies, tools) needed to correct expected system/component failures. Method of Compliance: The maintenance manuals are verified to contain troubleshooting procedures for those systems/components that are expected to fail as part of the normal operation of the air vehicle system. References: JSSG-2000: 3.6.1, 3.6.2 JSSG-2001: 3.1.5 14 CFR Part 23, Appendix G; Part 25, Appendix H

Standard: Maintenance publications include procedures for troubleshooting at each level of maintenance. Troubleshooting procedures describe the probable malfunctions and remedial actions for those malfunctions or isolate faulty item for repair or replacement. Troubleshooting procedures identify items (e.g., support equipment, supplies, tools) needed to perform the troubleshooting activities. Method of Compliance: Prior to entering flight test, verify the standard by the following method(s): Examination.
(1) Examine the maintenance publications to ensure troubleshooting procedures are included for each level of maintenance.
(2) Examine the troubleshooting procedures to ensure information to identify the fault and remedial action is included.
(3) Examine the artifacts that demonstrate contractor certification or contractor validation to ensure the maintenance publications have undergone a quality check for currency and accuracy IAW TO 00-5-3, Contractor Certification Process and Certification Requirements paragraphs for the Air Force; NAVAIR 00-25-604, Contractor Validation Plan and Validation paragraphs for the Navy; and DA PAM 25-40, Validation paragraphs for the Army. Demonstration.
  (1) Perform air vehicle maintainability demonstrations to confirm the troubleshooting procedures are complete, accurate, and can be performed as written without introducing AW hazards. Maintenance publications will receive updates to address maintenance issues discovered during maintainability demonstrations. Prior to entering operational test or operations, verify the standard by the following method(s): Demonstration.
  (2) Perform all air vehicle troubleshooting procedures on production-configured hardware using government maintenance personnel to ensure troubleshooting procedures do not introduce AW hazards.
